name: FAPESP Post-Doctoral Fellowship
amount: Monthly stipend per FAPESP table (fapesp.br/3162) + research overhead (Research Contingency Fund)
other_rules: PhD (Brazil or abroad) completed less than 7 years ago
supervisor must be employed at a São Paulo state research institution and have international research experience
notes: Applications any time (review about 75 days; slower Oct-Jan). Up to 36 months, renewable up to 48 if linked to certain grants. Many positions are advertised through FAPESP Opportunities linked to specific projects.

documents.name: Letter from head of host institution
